name: Finamp
author: djc
description: Winamp × VLC style media player for Omarchy — stream or download from a Tailscale Jellyfin/Plex server. Spectrum visualizer, seek/volume/speed HUD, 10-band EQ, playlist queue, library browser (Movies/Shows/Tracks/Albums), poster art, discovery of tailnet media servers via Tailscale MagicDNS. QML playback (QtMultimedia) with mpv fallback.

barWidget.description: Winamp×VLC tailscale media player — Jellyfin/Plex stream + download
